headline: BOMB DEFUSE goes online — five co-op titles now crew up over the relay
lede: The fifth PLAICRAFT co-op title joined the shared lobby: one URL, one seed, two hands. Lockstep sampling keeps key-turn simultaneity honest across the network; if your partner's link drops, the CPU takes their seat mid-run instead of freezing the frame.

notes.text: BOMB DEFUSE online (#1819, LIVE): ?net=host opens a DEFUSE CREW room, friends scan the QR or open the join link, the host kicks with SPACE. Both boxes run the same deterministic sim — tick 181 verified to hash 761819075 identically on two browsers in the drive.
Walkaway ≠ crash: 30 stalled ticks demote a dead seat to the engine's CPU partner on BOTH boxes — the run burns on. A guest left without a host drives both hands solo.

Harness lessons shipped too: the local relay twin now serves /status with CORS like the worker (WS-only twins made every drive's zero-page-error gate impossible), and on single-process Chrome boxes drives now fall back to two tabs in one context — a second isolated context SIGTRAPs the whole browser.
Proof stack: defuselinkdrive 14/14 (two real browsers over a live relay), defuselinkcheck 48/48 with a mutant-killed walkaway law, defusecheck 53/53, roomcheck 46/46, lobbycheck 65/65.
